name: YouTube Title Generator
title: AI YouTube Title Generator — Draft Better Video Titles
description: Explore YouTube title ideas from your topic and audience. AI-assisted drafts require a working provider; review accuracy and avoid misleading clickbait.
task: Generate alternative titles for a specific video instead of settling for the first headline. A useful brief includes the audience, what viewers will learn and the actual content of the video.
example: For a beginner tutorial about a small desk setup, ask for titles that explain the budget, room constraints and practical outcome. Do not claim results the video does not demonstrate.
review: Compare clarity, relevance and length. Remove exaggerated promises, unrelated keywords and repetitive openings. A title can support discovery but cannot guarantee views or a particular search position.

name: Blog Writer
title: AI Blog Writer — Create an Editable Article Draft
description: Draft a blog article from a topic, audience and outline using AI. A working provider is required. Check facts, sources and originality before publishing.
task: Get a starting draft for a blog post by specifying the reader's question, the scope and the structure you want. Include source material you have permission to use when specific facts matter.
example: Ask for an introductory article about organizing a home office for freelance designers, with sections on lighting, desk space and workflow. Supply real product specifications instead of asking the model to guess them.
review: Verify every factual claim, remove invented quotations or references and add experience that makes the article useful. The tool is a drafting assistant, not an originality certificate or guaranteed SEO ranking service.

name: Ad Copy
title: AI Ad Copy Generator — Campaign Drafts & Variations
description: Generate advertising copy ideas from a product, audience and offer. Requires a working AI provider. Review claims, platform policies and brand voice.
task: Explore several ways to communicate an offer without changing the underlying facts. Tell the tool your audience, product benefit, campaign channel and the action you want the reader to take.
example: For a scheduling app, describe the real features, pricing and audience before requesting short ad variants. Keep any trial duration or discount exactly aligned with the actual offer.
review: Remove unsupported performance claims and prohibited targeting language. Check the ad platform's rules and your industry's requirements. Generated copy does not guarantee approval, conversions or profitable advertising.

name: Script Generator
title: AI Video Script Generator — Hooks, Structure & CTA
description: Draft a video script with a hook, clear sections and a call to action. AI generation needs a working provider; adapt timing and facts before recording.
task: Turn a video idea into an ordered script that can be rehearsed and edited. Include your intended duration, format, audience knowledge and the key points that must be covered.
example: For a two-minute desk-organization tutorial, ask for an opening problem, three practical steps and a closing action. Specify where demonstrations or on-screen examples should replace spoken explanation.
review: Read the script aloud to test timing and natural speech. Verify facts, remove empty transitions and keep the opening promise consistent with the actual video. Runtime estimates are not exact until rehearsed.

name: Facebook Caption
title: AI Facebook Caption Generator — Draft Social Posts
description: Create Facebook caption ideas from your topic, tone and audience. Working AI provider required. Edit for your brand and verify every offer or claim.
task: Find caption options that fit the post's actual image, purpose and audience. Describe the event, product or story rather than supplying only a generic topic.
example: For a small business sharing a new workspace, request a warm caption explaining why the change matters to customers. Add the real location or opening date yourself if those details are not provided.
review: Check that captions do not invent testimonials, promotions or customer reactions. Use a clear invitation to engage instead of misleading engagement bait. Posting a generated caption does not guarantee reach.

name: Content Calendar
title: AI Content Calendar Generator — Plan Your Next Month
description: Draft a content calendar around your audience, goals and publishing capacity. Requires a working AI provider. Review dates and adapt the schedule.
task: Organize topics and formats into a plan you can actually maintain. Include the platforms you use, how often you can publish and what business or creative goal each post should support.
example: A freelancer might request three weekly posts: one educational tip, one process example and one useful answer to a client question. Reserve room for timely updates rather than scheduling every day automatically.
review: Verify dates, holidays and campaign information. Check that you have time and material for every proposed item. The output is a planning draft, not a publishing scheduler or a promise of audience growth.

name: SEO Description Generator
title: AI YouTube Description Generator — Clear Video Summaries
description: Draft a YouTube description that explains your video and relevant keywords. Requires a working AI provider; verify links and facts before posting.
task: Write a description that helps viewers understand what the video covers. Supply the key lessons, audience and any real resources or links you want included.
example: For a tutorial on a spreadsheet budget, describe the workflow demonstrated and provide the actual template link. Ask for a concise opening and a structured resource section without keyword stuffing.
review: Do not publish invented timestamps, links or affiliate disclosures. Add accurate disclosures where required and verify every URL. A description can make a video easier to understand but does not guarantee search placement.

name: Thumbnail Ideas
title: AI YouTube Thumbnail Ideas — Concepts for Your Video
description: Generate thumbnail concept ideas for a video topic. A working AI provider is required. This tool suggests concepts, not downloadable thumbnail images.
task: Explore visual directions before creating an actual thumbnail. Give the tool the video's subject, the emotion or contrast you want to communicate and any brand constraints.
example: For a desk makeover, compare a before-and-after composition with a close-up of the main improvement. Tell the tool whether faces, text overlays or product photos are available.
review: Use ideas as a creative brief, not as evidence that an image has been generated. Avoid misleading visuals and make sure you own or can license the source material. For existing video images, use the separate thumbnail downloader.

name: Hook Generator
title: AI Hook Generator — Opening Lines for Videos & Posts
description: Explore opening lines for videos or social posts using AI. Provider setup is required. Pick a hook that accurately matches the content you deliver.
task: Create alternative opening lines that help the right audience recognize why a piece of content matters. Explain the problem you solve and what follows after the opening.
example: For a guide to planning a week of posts, ask for question-based, benefit-led and common-mistake openings. Supply the actual process so the hook does not promise a result the guide cannot deliver.
review: Choose clarity over artificial urgency. Remove unsupported numbers and exaggerated guarantees. Test the opening alongside audience retention and usefulness, not only clicks.

name: Rewrite & Improve
title: AI Text Rewriter — Improve Clarity, Tone & Structure
description: Rewrite a draft for clearer wording, tone or structure. Requires a working AI provider. Compare the result with the original to preserve meaning.
task: Refine an existing passage rather than starting from scratch. Tell the tool whether the priority is clarity, brevity, a different tone or a better sequence of ideas.
example: Paste a rough project update and request a concise professional version that preserves deadlines, decisions and open questions. Clearly identify any exact wording that must remain unchanged.
review: Compare names, numbers, commitments and technical meaning against the source. Rewriting does not remove copyright obligations or certify originality. Do not send confidential material without permission.

name: Repurpose Content
title: AI Content Repurposing Tool — Adapt One Idea
description: Adapt source content into drafts for different channels with AI. A working provider is required. Preserve facts and tailor each draft before sharing.
task: Reuse the substance of a good piece of content while adapting its presentation for other formats. Provide the source text and identify the platforms or outputs you need.
example: Turn a useful article into a short video outline, a social caption and an email summary. Ask each version to emphasize the same central lesson while fitting the context of its platform.
review: Check that facts and nuance survive the transformation. Do not assume a shorter version can omit necessary qualifications. Use only source content you own or have permission to adapt.

name: Product Description
title: AI Product Description Generator — Clear Product Copy
description: Draft product descriptions from supplied features and audience needs. Working AI provider required. Verify specifications, benefits and claims.
task: Translate accurate product information into understandable copy. Supply dimensions, materials, functionality and the intended buyer instead of asking a model to infer them from a product name.
example: For a desk lamp, provide the actual brightness settings, power source and dimensions. Ask for a short benefit-led paragraph plus a factual feature list for an online store.
review: Check every specification, warranty statement and compatibility claim. Avoid invented certifications, medical benefits and sustainability promises. The output does not replace legal or marketplace compliance review.

name: Competitor Angle
title: AI Competitor Angle Generator — Explore Positioning Ideas
description: Brainstorm positioning angles from the competitor context you provide. AI provider required; this tool does not independently verify competitors.
task: Explore ways to explain a different approach to a customer problem. Supply factual competitor observations, your own strengths and the audience you want to serve.
example: A freelance design studio can compare its real turnaround process and specialization with public competitor descriptions. Ask for constructive positioning options, not unsupported negative claims about another business.
review: Validate every comparison using reliable current information. The model is not conducting verified live competitor research here. Avoid defamatory statements and claims you cannot substantiate.
